scope: Actual source refresh singleton/Unity Update, offnet readiness coroutine, compressed file save/restart, ExitGame and scaled await cleanup. SDK clock values/result messages are explicit test inputs; no production Main, platform response or Player claim.
checks: Actual pool readiness prevents scheduler registration and launch count
Native singleton root reuses one component and one lifecycle subscription
Registration finishes during pause but scheduler waits for scaled time
First actual scheduler Update aligns midnight and resets daily count while retaining lifetime count
Automatic initial refresh persists through native owner Update and gzip file storage
Actual next-day scheduler tick resets daily data exactly at the duration boundary
Cross-day timestamp committed without invoking refresh callback from the harness
Real ordinary ExitGame message clears scheduler registry immediately
Native destruction removes scheduler lifecycle delegate after owner release
Independent owner graph restores automatic refresh timestamps and counts from compressed file
Restart registers fresh launch but actual scheduler ticks do not duplicate same-day reset
Disposal callback begins native scaled wait before clearing registry
Scaled cleanup stays pending during pause while queued owner removal completes
Native await clears registry after resume and retains source singleton/lifecycle subscription
Final destruction clears records and unregisters cleanup
